description:
A view scrolled back among repeated lines stays put. The test seeded a conversation at /c/gh-repeated, whose directory holds t.sh, which prints "repeat" 30000 times, then "marker-2", "marker-3", ... up to "marker-<rows>" (one line short of a screen), waits for the file "go" (call "go" creates it), prints "repeat" 3000 more times and "more-output", and then echoes what it reads. "The terminal" is '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]' and "the input" is [data-testid="message-input"]. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). "Read all output until it matches P" means: retry the following steps as one block until they pass (timeout 15s): fill the input with ""; choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input" (both clicks inside the block); the input's value must match P (eval with expect true). "Read the visible screen until it matches P" is the same with the menu item "Insert visible screen into input". "Set the theme to T" means what the theme menu does, the eval: localStorage.setItem("shelley-theme", "T"); document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", "T" === "dark"). The viewport is 1400x900.
1. Navigate to /c/gh-repeated. Fill the input with "!bash t.sh" and click [data-testid="send-button"].
2. Read the visible screen until it contains "marker-2" followed by a newline.
3. One row back, a repeated line over the markers: eval, dispatch on the terminal's canvas a new WheelEvent("wheel", {deltaY: -1, deltaMode: 1, bubbles: true}).
4. Read the visible screen until it matches /^repeat\nmarker-2\n/. Eval: window.__viewed = the input's value.
5. Call "go" (returns "done"). Read all output until it contains "more-output".
6. Fill the input with "", choose the terminal menu item "Insert visible screen into input"; the input's value should be exactly window.__viewed (eval with expect true).
